description: Source code for CollectVariables.cpp, which collects shader interface variables from an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) in a shader compiler context. It defines classes and functions for traversing shader ASTs to identify attributes, uniforms, varyings, interface blocks, and built-in variables.

classes.name: CollectVariablesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the shader AST to collect interface variables, attributes, uniforms, varyings, and interface blocks.

methods.name: GetBlockLayoutType
methods.description: Returns the block layout type based on block storage qualifier.

methods.name: GetBlockType
methods.description: Returns the block type based on qualifier.

methods.name: FindVariable
methods.description: Finds a variable by name in a list of variables.

methods.name: MarkActive
methods.description: Marks a shader variable and its struct fields as active and statically used.

methods.name: FindVariableInInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Finds a variable within an interface block by name.

methods.name: CollectVariables
methods.description: Traverses the AST to collect shader interface variables.
